Mod.Name: FF8 Unlimited
Mod.Author: BreDoyliesSea
Mod.Description:
Lifts FF8's list limits and lets you pick the Triple Triad rules. Each part is an option in Configure and can be switched off on its own.
◆ All Magic Per Character ◆ • Every character holds every spell at once (64 slots instead of 32), up to 100 each. • Every magic screen pages through them: magic menu, draw, refine, junction and auto-junction, item and exchange screens. • The extra magic is kept in your normal save; older saves are converted when loaded. Saves made with it need it on to load their magic.
◆ Unlimited GF Abilities ◆ • No 22-ability limit per GF: teach any number of abilities with items, no Amnesia Greens needed. • The GF menu Learn list, the item teach/forget list and the junction GF ability popup page through all of them. • Saves stay in the vanilla format.
◆ Card rules ◆ • Open, Same, Plus, Random, Sudden Death, Same Wall, Elemental: Region default, Always on or Always off. • Trade rule: Region default, One, Diff, Direct, All or None. Applies to every match in every region.
Page numbers past 9 show both digits (P.12).
Requires the Steam 2013 English release (FF8_EN.exe). Not for the Remastered edition, other languages or the 2000 release.
Dev note - memory this mod uses (only while that part is on): • All Magic: code cave 0x24B6000-0x24B6572 and data 0x24B5000-0x24B5B28, 0x25D5000-0x25D7980 (unused .data); about 440 patched sites. • GF Abilities: code cave 0xB68940-0xB68C0E (end of .text) and data 0x400400-0x400860 (PE header tail). • Card rules: code cave 0xB68E00-0xB68E3D (end of .text); hook at 0x522652. • Page numbers: rewrites 0x4C0370-0x4C03D7 in place.

LatestVersion.ReleaseNotes: Version 1.1: • Combines Triple Triad Rule Select, Unlimited GF Abilities and All Magic Per Character into one mod with options. Page numbers past 9 show two digits.
